SkillFoundry 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an end-to-end pipeline for discovering, validating, and generating Skill packages based on real public demand.
- Scans multiple sources (live public requirements, ClawHub skill popularity, bug reports, adjacent workflows) and corroborates ideas with evidence.
- Automatically deduplicates, rates, and implements only the highest scoring unique requirements (threshold: 90/100, minimum 3 sources).
- Generates bilingual documentation and outputs organized catalogs, reviews, scoring reports, and implementation folders.
- Supports optional publishing to ClawHub and GitHub targets via CLI flags and standard authentication.
- Enforces strict review, duplicate handling, and quality standards on all generated skills.
